title: Gravitas Evidence Entry
description: A runtime event or criterion-linked proof in the append-only evidence ledger.

criterion.description: Acceptance criterion satisfied by this evidence.

evidence.description: Observed evidence, preferably including verbatim validator output.

file.description: Path associated with a read or write event; null marks an untracked/unknown write target.

file_sha256.description: Content hash captured for a successfully read regular file; read-before-write accepts it only while the file still matches.

phase.description: Reproduction phase: before (failing evidence) or after (fix verification).

reproducer_id.description: Contract-declared reproducer associated with this execution.

working_directory.description: Resolved working directory used by a reproducer execution.

sensitive.description: Read touched a likely secret-bearing file; treat retained content accordingly.

anchor_pending.description: Ledger entry written while the user-local anchor store was unavailable; verification treats it as a fail-closed deficit until a later anchor covers it.

anchor_error.description: Anchor-store failure that caused anchor_pending to be set.

timed_out.description: Execution hit the wall-clock bound; verdict is FAIL.

output_snippet.description: Bounded diagnostic output; must be scrubbed of credentials and personal data.
